question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, why did the pristine framework BC-0, with its larger BET surface area, adsorb more CO2 than BC-10?
rendered: The excerpts do not indicate that the pristine framework BC-0 adsorbed more CO2 than BC-10. In fact, it is stated that BC-10 exhibited the highest equilibrium CO2 adsorption capacity of approximately 1.77 mmol g−1, which is approximately 52% higher than BC-0 (1.16 mmol g−1).
